title: On-call handoff draft - Zoe Park
content:
Shift summary (TZ: PST)

- Time window: 2026-03-03 20:00 -> 2026-03-04 08:00
- Pager load: moderate (2 P1s, 1 P2)
- Systems monitored: serving-runtime, autoscaler, redis-cache, kafka ingestion
- Primary oncall: Zoe Park (me). Handoff out to: Samir Ali at 08:00 PST.

Incidents (high level)

1) P1 - serving-runtime OOMs on model-worker-23
   - Timeline: 2026-03-03 23:12 detected by SLO alert (error budget spike)
   - Symptom: high OOM kills on model-worker-23, restart loop; requests routed to worker pool causing increased latency (p90 -> 850ms).
   - Immediate mitigation: cordoned model-worker-23 from autoscaler pool, scaled up spare pool +2 nodes, restarted worker with reduced batch_size (from 8 -> 4) and enabled kv-cache-restore=false for that worker.
   - Current status: worker stable since 23:48, error rates returned to baseline at 00:10. Postmortem ticket: JIRA-OPS-4821.
   - Follow-ups: investigate memory regression in recent runtime patch (PR #1257); repro on staging with long-context model. Owner: Samir.

2) P2 - slow embeddings job backlog (dedicated cluster)
   - Timeline: 2026-03-04 02:30 observed backlog growth on metrics dashboard
   - Symptom: batch job retries due to transient 503s from dedicated-embed-02; CPU saturation on that host.
   - Immediate mitigation: temporarily requeued high-priority jobs to dedicated-embed-03, increased retry backoff, disabled proactive compaction job that coincided with spike.
   - Current status: backlog decreasing, expected to clear by 10:00 PST. Follow-up: tune compaction scheduling and add CPU headroom. Owner: Maya.

Ongoing maintenance / known issues

- Autoscaler regression: a recent fix to scale-down aggressiveness (PR #1274) can cause flapping when pod startups are slow. We reverted the change on prod-auto-1 cluster at 2026-03-02 18:00 but test remains. Tracking ticket: JIRA-OPS-4790.
- Redis cache eviction tuning: observed small increase in cache misses for prefix cache during heavy chat workloads; likely due to recent model variants using larger KV caches. Temporary mitigation: bump redis-memory-limits on cache-prod-2 by 2GB (applied 2026-03-03 21:00).

Temporary procedures / quick runbook (for whoever picks up)

- High-level triage steps for serving-runtime OOM (quick):
  1) Check alerts: PagerDuty + Grafana alert link in slack message -> snapshot of worker OOMs.
  2) Identify worker(s) by hostname in logs: kubectl -n inference get pods | grep model-worker
  3) Describe pod + events: kubectl describe pod <podname>
  4) If OOMLoopBackOff, cordon pod from service routing: kubectl label pod <pod> maintenance=true --overwrite
  5) Scale up spare pool: kubectl scale deployment spare-workers --replicas=<current+2>
  6) Restart failing worker with reduced batch_size env var: kubectl set env deployment/<worker-deploy> BATCH_SIZE=4
  7) If memory regression suspected, roll back runtime image to previous tag: kubectl set image deployment/<worker-deploy> runtime=registry/redwood/runtime:2026-03-01
  8) Post an update in slack #sre-oncall and create/update JIRA with timeline.

- Embeddings backlog hotfix:
  - If dedicated-embed-02 CPU > 85% and retry rate climbing:
    a) Pause low-priority jobs: curl -X POST $JOB_API/pause?queue=low
    b) Requeue high-priority to dedicated-embed-03: update job tag and reroute via job-controller UI
    c) Notify CS and product owners (list below) with ETA for backlog clear.

Escalation contacts (in order)
- Oncall lead: Maya Singh (pager) - +1-555-0123
- Eng SRE manager: Jordan Lee - +1-555-0156
- Platform eng: Priya Menon (Slack) - @priya

Follow-ups / action items (not exhaustive)
- [ ] Reproduce memory regression locally with PR #1257 changes. Owner: Samir. Due: 2026-03-07.
- [ ] Adjust autoscaler tests to cover slow pod startups before re-landing PR #1274. Owner: Zoe. Due: 2026-03-10.
- [ ] Tune compaction schedule on dedicated-embed clusters. Owner: Maya. Due: 2026-03-09.
- [ ] Add a runbook snippet to Confluence for rapid OOM mitigation (link above). Owner: Zoe. Due: 2026-03-08.

Useful links & commands
- Grafana alerts dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/alerts/serving-runtime
- Postmortem ticket: https://jira.internal/browse/JIRA-OPS-4821
- Runtime PRs to check: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pulls (look for #1257, #1274)
- Slack channel: #sre-oncall

Notes to self (things to document in final runbook)
- Need a short checklist for when to roll back runtime image vs tweak env vars (batch_size, kv-cache-restore).
- Consider adding warm pool healthchecks before routing traffic to newly started workers to avoid flapping.

End of handoff. Leaving more context in the linked Jira and the slack thread pinned to this channel.

-- Zoe
summary: Shift handoff draft covering P1 OOM on model-worker-23 (mitigated), P2 embeddings backlog, temporary procedures and follow-ups.
